description: This file defines a class DefaultSignatureAppearanceHandler that implements the IAnnotationAppearanceHandler interface. It is responsible for drawing the visual signature appearance in a PDF, including signer information, location, reason, and date, with customizable properties.

classes.name: DefaultSignatureAppearanceHandler
classes.description: A sample implementation of an appearance handler that renders signature visual information onto a PDF using the PdfSharp library.

methods.name: DrawAppearance
methods.description: Draws the signature appearance including signer info, location, reason, and date onto the specified graphics area.
